description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the List View page in the vtiger CRM system. It manages the display of list entries for a specific module, including permissions, custom views, sorting, navigation, and rendering via Smarty templates.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class handling custom views in modules, providing view management and permissions.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM page rendering.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the current custom view ID for the module.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Returns HTML for the custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific custom view by its ID.

methods.name: isPermittedChangeStatus
methods.description: Checks if changing the status of a custom view is permitted.

methods.name: isPermittedCustomView
methods.description: Checks permission for a user to perform actions on a custom view.

methods.name: getModifiedCvListQuery
methods.description: Modifies the base list query according to the custom view.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Retrieves the current page number for list pagination.
